causality.rule: event_time = formation-bar OPEN; condition knowable only at formation-bar close_time (= available_at); engine fills at first candle open_time > event_time (= entry_time). Causal iff entry_time >= available_at on the traded chain.
causality.per_trade_check: 1412/1412 trades with available_at present and entry_time >= available_at; 0 violations; 0 null.
causality.gap_entry_minus_available_ms: uniformly 1 (venue close_time = next open - 1ms on the intact chain).
causality.gap_note: No gaps or misalignments exist in this window (chain intact), so the 'next open' rule coincides exactly with first-knowable-instant entry here. On a gapped chain the engine still fills at the next known open (>= available_at by construction) and resolves exits gap-first; reference_price never prices a fill.
causality.availability_limit: Live-signal availability at that instant remains UNKNOWN (no streaming-formation proof); the replay proves mechanical causality, not tradability.

exposure.scope: max_concurrent=1 applies INSIDE one run_backtest invocation = one (symbol-run, group, segment, scale) cell. Symbols replay in separate processes with symbol-pinned calendars (foreign-symbol run is REJECTED fail-closed); groups replay in separate calls with separate open-interval ledgers; dev/oos replay separately.
exposure.consequence: Overlapping events from different groups (e.g. H1 LONG vs H3 SHORT) or different symbols NEVER compete: both trade. The 145 overlap skips are strictly within same symbol+group+segment (worst: SOL continuation-dev 52/167 = 31%).
exposure.pooled: pooled_reference is the arithmetic sum over independent single-position replays. It is NOT a portfolio with one simultaneous position: it can imply concurrent positions across symbols/groups and carries no cross-margin, no portfolio-level concurrency limit, and no simultaneous-exposure P&L model. Simultaneous exposure is unmodeled.

units.expectancy_gross: USDT of gross (pre-friction) P&L per trade on $1000 fixed notional @1x; H1/H3 cells span +1.88...+3.11/trade (rounded '+1.9...+3.1/op' in prose).
units.expectancy_net: USDT net per trade on $1000 notional @1x after ASSUMED friction (COST-ASSUME-v1).
units.friction: measured from replay: gross-net ~= 1.60/trade (fees ~1.00 at 5bps x2 legs on ~$1000 + assumed spread/slip ~0.60 at 3bps x2 legs). The draft 'friction ~= 1.0/trade' is CORRECTED: 1.0 covers commissions only, not spread+slip. All three legs are assumptions (fee tier unknown, no spread/depth history), never measurements.
units.totals: TotalR likewise in USDT per $1000-notional replay (e.g. SOL H1-oos TotalR +155.11R over 137 realized trades). R-suffix marks realized-only (open marks excluded).
units.costs: 5/1/2bps are versioned assumptions (COST-ASSUME-v1, engine defaults untouched), NOT measured venue costs.
